summary: Cadrenal Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce the completion of its End-of-Phase 2 meeting with the FDA and receipt of guidance for the Phase 3 pivotal trial of CAD-1005, a 12-LOX inhibitor for heparin-induced thrombocytopenia. The filing includes a press release furnished under Item 7.01 and 8.01. No financial terms, board recommendations, or strategic transactions are disclosed. The disclosure is a routine regulatory update on clinical development, not a special situation event. The registrant is the issuer reporting material non-public information about its drug development program.
